Company description: KO (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

The Coca-Cola Company (KO) is the world’s largest non-alcoholic beverage corporation, operating a vast portfolio that includes sparkling soft drinks, water, sports drinks, juices, and coffee. Founded in 1886 by pharmacist John Stith Pemberton in Atlanta, Georgia, the company originated with the invention of its flagship product, Coca-Cola, which was famously marketed as a patent medicine before becoming a global cultural icon. 

Today, the company functions primarily as a brand owner and franchisor, managing a sophisticated global network of independent bottling partners that manufacture, package, and distribute its products. With a presence in over 200 countries and territories, Coca-Cola maintains a dominant market position through an extensive distribution infrastructure and a diverse brand lineup, which includes household names such as Sprite, Fanta, Dasani, and Minute Maid. Headquartered in Atlanta, the company remains a cornerstone of the consumer staples sector and a long-standing component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, consistently focusing on brand equity, innovation, and global supply chain optimization to sustain its leadership in the beverage industry.
